description: Elevated glassFloating headline card for the transaction-list screen. Leads with the net money number for the currently visible (possibly filtered) set, with an income/expense split, item count, and an optional active-filter pill that can be cleared.

mode.description: Drives label and hero color: net→NET THIS LIST, category→SPENT IN THIS CATEGORY, day→ON THIS DAY

filterLabel.description: Category or day label shown in the active-filter pill

filterIcon.description: Ionicons name for the pill (pricetag / calendar-outline)

tokens.label: typography.caption + colors.textMuted (uppercase)
tokens.hero: typography.h2, color via getValueColor(net) — colors.error for all-expense category

accessibility.label: Net for this list {net}. Income {income}, expenses {expense}, {count} items.

notes: Omit a split column whose value is 0. Keep income and expense separate; derive net last — never pre-blend.
